entry.title: Barghouti hopes Arab surge in Israel vote removes 'fascist ministers'

media:group.media:title: Barghouti hopes Arab surge in Israel vote removes 'fascist ministers'
media:group.media:description:
"I hope this will have an impact on removing the most fascist ministers in the Israeli government, responsible for terrible attacks and ethnic cleansing in the West Bank."
Palestinian National Initiative Secretary-General Dr Mustafa Barghouti tells #EuropeToday after Arab parties in Israel scored a historic election result, almost doubling their seats in the Knesset.
